derivations.quote: Each digit polynomial has degree at most $q-1$, so the product polynomial has degree at most $2q-2$.
The cyclic convolution of length $S$ is the product modulo $x^S-1$, where $x^S=1$ folds the term $x^j$ onto $x^{j \bmod S}$. Every exponent $j$ is at most $2q-2<S$, so nothing folds.
Each $c_j$ is a sum of at most $q$ products $u_iv_k$, each between $0$ and $(2^b-1)^2$. Hence $0\le c_j\le q(2^b-1)^2$.

relations.quote: Multiplication therefore reduces to a [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md) of length $S$ on short integer coefficients.

symbols.name: first input
symbols.meaning: The first of the two integers being multiplied.

symbols.name: second input
symbols.meaning: The second of the two integers being multiplied.

symbols.name: digit bits
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in one radix-2^b digit.
symbols.quote: Let $n$ be the number of bits in each input, and let $b=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ be the number of bits in one digit, so $n\le 2^b$.

symbols.name: padded length
symbols.meaning: A power of two with 4n/b <= T < 8n/b, the padded length from parameter choice.
symbols.quote: $T$ is the padded length, a power of two with $4n/b\le T<8n/b$.

symbols.name: convolution length
symbols.meaning: The length of the cyclic convolution, a product of distinct odd primes with T/2 < S < T.
symbols.quote: $S$ is the length of the cyclic convolution, a product of distinct odd primes with $T/2<S<T$.

symbols.name: digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of digits in each input.
symbols.quote: Let $q=\lceil n/b\rceil$ be the number of digits in each input, padding with leading zeros.

symbols.name: digit of u
symbols.meaning: The digit of u of weight 2^{bi}, an integer below 2^b.
symbols.quote: Write $u=\sum_{i=0}^{q-1}u_i2^{bi}$ and $v=\sum_{k=0}^{q-1}v_k2^{bk}$, where the digits $u_i$ and $v_k$ are integers with $0\le u_i,v_k<2^b$.

symbols.name: digit of v
symbols.meaning: The digit of v of weight 2^{bk}, an integer below 2^b.
symbols.quote: Write $u=\sum_{i=0}^{q-1}u_i2^{bi}$ and $v=\sum_{k=0}^{q-1}v_k2^{bk}$, where the digits $u_i$ and $v_k$ are integers with $0\le u_i,v_k<2^b$.

symbols.name: polynomial variable
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of the digit polynomials.
symbols.quote: Let $x$ be a polynomial variable, and form the polynomials in $x$ with the $u_i$ and with the $v_k$ as coefficients.

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of x^j in the product of the two digit polynomials.
symbols.quote: Let $c_j=\sum_{i+k=j}u_iv_k$ be the coefficient of $x^j$ in that product.
